# The competition is cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak.

This is the Tri-State 2020 Championship. The top ranking resident in each event will be crowned Tri-State Champion! This competition is open to all competitors, but only Tri-State residents may be awarded the title of Tri-State Champion.
